title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA BACKEND (JAVA/KOTLIN) PLENO - REMOTO
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • - Desenvolver software utilizando as tecnologias Java, Kotlin (Desejável), Framework Spring.
  • - Realizar a integração com bancos de dados, como relacional e não relacionais.
  • - Desejável conhecer sobre Cloud e seus mais variados serviços.
  • - Boas práticas, entender sobre qualidade, SOLID, e Clean Code.
  • - Trabalhar em equipe para garantir a entrega de soluções eficazes
  • - Comunicar-se de forma eficaz para alinhar expectativas e resultados
  • - Demonstrar proatividade na resolução de problemas e busca por melhorias contínuas
  • - Adaptar-se a novos desafios e tecnologias conforme necessário


Requisitos e qualificações


  • - Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas relacionadas
  • - Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e conhecimento em Java, Kotlin, Framework Spring.
  • - Conhecimento em bancos de dados, relacionais e não relacionais.
  • - Habilidade em trabalho em equipe, comunicação eficaz, proatividade, resolução de problemas e adaptabilidade
  • - Cursos relacionados a Desenvolvimento de Software e Certificações na área de Tecnologia são diferenciais
  • - Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Software e participação em eventos e conferências da área são valorizados


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks , voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices , including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning , GANs , or edge AI deployments .
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks , voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices , including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning , GANs , or edge AI deployments .
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Consultor de vendas online
description:
❌Não vamos analisar currículos sem experiência na área

❌Avaga não é para quem quer só uma renda extra no Home Office


Somos uma agência de turismo 100% online e com foco na venda de passeios para Santiago do Chile e Deserto do Atacama e Peru.


Precisamos de um consultor de vendas PJ com experiência em vendas através do WhatsApp (Não iremos entrevistar quem não tiver experiência na área de vedas).


A vaga será para período integral e você poderá trabalhar 100% de forma remota. A contratação será de forma PJ.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Vender de forma consultivas os passeios para Santiago do Chile e Deserto de Atacama;
  • Organização dos processos e cumprimento dos prazos combinados;


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Para ser Consultor(a) de vendas é importante:
  • Ter vontade de vender e ser motivado por metas;
  • Ter uma ótima organização;
  • Habilidade de atuar com metas e orientação para resultados;
  • Boa comunicação e lidar bem com público;
  • Agilidade no atendimento e respostas;
  • Facilidade de memorização e aprendizagem;
  • Proatividade.


Disponibilidade de trabalho entre 09:00 e 18:00 com 1h de almoço (com intercalações em fins de semanas e turnos da noite);

Disponibilidade para trabalhar com escala em fins de semana e feriados;

Ter CNPJ (vaga PJ);

Ter notebook e microfone em casa;


Remuneração

  • Fixo de R$ 2.000 (negociável) + Percentual variável de acordo com a meta sobre todas as vendas + Bônus de até R$900 por metas batidas. Oportunidade de crescimento na liderança de equipe.

title: Gerente de Projetos de TI Sênior (Inglês Fluente)
description:
A Stefanini LATAM está em busca de um Gerente de Projetos Sênior bilíngue para atuar diretamente com um de nossos Gerentes Comerciais, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas em clientes globais, especialmente no universo de Dados e IA .

Trata-se de um papel crucial, combinando atuação como PM hands-on e parceiro PMO , garantindo governança, visibilidade e entrega estruturada de múltiplos projetos.


Modelo de Contratação

  • Contratação: Contractor / PJ via Deel - Stefanini LATAM
  • Dedicação: Full-time (exclusivo)
  • Local: 100% Remoto
  • Projeto de longa duração


O profissional ideal tem experiência sólida em gestão de ponta a ponta, alta capacidade de comunicação em inglês e habilidade em traduzir progresso, riscos e próximos passos para stakeholders de alto nível.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o ciclo completo de projetos (possivelmente em iniciativas de Dados e IA);
  • Atuar como braço direito de um Gerente Comercial, garantindo alinhamento, governança e entregas estruturadas;
  • Executar atividades de PMO: reports consolidados, acompanhamento de progresso, documentação, gestão de riscos e issues.
  • Facilitar cerimônias e workshops (Lean Inception, práticas Ágeis, etc.).
  • Coordenar times multifuncionais e assegurar cumprimento de prazos, escopo e orçamento.
  • Comunicar-se com excelência em inglês (oral e escrito).


Requisitos

  • 7+ anos de experiência como Gerente de Projetos ou PMO em ambientes de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e Cascata.
  • Experiência prática com Lean Inception .
  • Inglês fluente (C1+).
  • Experiência prévia com clientes de grande porte/globais.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos fluxos e consolidar informações de forma clara.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações PMP , Scrum Master , PMO ou similares.
  • Vivência em projetos de Dados, Analytics, IA ou ecossistemas tecnológicos complexos.



Se você é um líder de entrega estruturado, com excelente comunicação e paixão por organizar e impulsionar projetos estratégicos, queremos conversar com você!

title: Azure Devops Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain cloud-native solutions across our Retail technology landscape. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to align DevOps practices with business goals, supporting ITIL processes, and ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and manage CI/CD pipelines for Retail applications.
  • Deploy and operate containerized workloads using AKS and Kubernetes.
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, integrations, and application environments.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, ARM templates, and scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
  • Implement observability and alerting using Azure Monitor and Grafana.
  • Support incident, problem, and change management processes.
  • Ensure cloud security, vulnerability management, and networking troubleshooting.
  • Perform SQL-based tasks and support BI/reporting workflows.
  • Participate in disaster recovery planning and testing.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years in technology with strong DevOps and Azure cloud expertise.
  • Deep knowledge of Azure services, AKS, networking, security, storage, databases, and containerization.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab).
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, PowerShell, C#, Java, etc.).
  • Proficient with SQL Server and BI tools (SSIS/SSRS/SSAS).
  • Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CloudFormation) and configuration management (Ansible, Chef).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills; familiarity with SRE and ITIL practices.

Desired Qualifications

  • Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  • Experience working with retail or wholesale trading systems

title: Medical Assistant
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM) – Full-Time

Salary: USD 750–800 per month (≈ USD 4.7/hr)

Contract Type: Independent Contractor

Equipment Required: Computer/laptop + reliable internet


Overview

We are seeking a Virtual Assistant / Front Office Call Center Coordinator to join a fast-paced, multi-specialty medical facility serving patients across Neurology, Mental Health, Hormone Therapy, and Ketamine Therapy. Our client is committed to delivering exceptional, patient-centered care, and this role is key to ensuring smooth operations and outstanding patient experiences.

As the first point of contact for many patients, you will handle high-volume calls, schedule appointments across multiple providers, update EMR systems, and resolve patient inquiries with empathy and professionalism.


Responsibilities

Patient Scheduling & Coordination

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel appointments across multiple clinics and providers.
  • Manage scheduling changes, follow-ups, reminders, and patient rescheduling.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff to ensure smooth patient flow and minimize delays.

Patient Communication & Support

  • Answer a high volume of incoming calls with professionalism and urgency.
  • Provide information about services, treatment plans, and appointment details.
  • Assist patients with questions, concerns, and general inquiries.
  • Handle upset or confused patients with empathy, patience, and clear communication.
  • Make outbound calls for reminders, confirmations, and follow-ups.

Administrative & EMR Management

  • Update and maintain accurate patient records in Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems.
  • Use scheduling software to manage calendars across multiple providers.
  • Perform administrative support tasks to assist front office operations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and timely entry of patient information.


Requirements

  • Advanced English (written and spoken); bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
  • 1+ year of experience in call centers, customer service, or front-desk roles within the healthcare sector .
  • Experience handling high-volume calls and assisting patients with inquiries, rescheduling, and support.
  • Familiarity with EMR systems and scheduling software .
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Excellent communication skills, customer service mindset, and professional phone etiquette.
  • High attention to detail, accurate data entry, and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, patience, and strong problem-solving abilities when dealing with patients.
  • Tech-savvy; comfortable learning new systems.
  • Reliable computer/laptop with camera and microphone + stable internet connection.

title: Engenheiro Machine Learning Sênior
description:
Engenheiro de Machine Learning Senior


Requisitos:

Experiência sólida com engenharia de software aplicada a dados e machine learning.

Proficiência em Python e frameworks como PySpark, Pandas, Scikit-learn ou similares.

Experiência com ferramentas e serviços AWS, como S3, Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, Athena, SageMaker ou ECS.

Conhecimento em MLOps e CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos.

Experiência com orquestração de workflows.

Capacidade de escrever código limpo, modular e testável.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation).

Participação em projetos de ML em produção com foco em confiabilidade e rastreabilidade.


Responsabilidades principais:

Projetar e implementar pipelines de validação de dados e avaliação de modelos em ambiente cloud (AWS).

Integrar dados e métricas de avaliação em um fluxo automatizado e auditável.

Modularizar o pipeline para facilitar reuso, testes e manutenção.

Trabalhar em colaboração com times de Data Science, Engenharia de Dados e Produto.

Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, logging, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Propor melhorias contínuas na arquitetura de dados e nos processos de validação.


Modelo de atuação: Remoto

title: Desenvolvedor Java PL
description:
Cód. 55111


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


· Ei Dev, quer trabalhar em uma empresa com plano de carreira que coloca você como protagonista?


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvimento de microserviços em Java e Spring Boot
  • Integração com RabbitMQ , AWS SQS e SNS (filas/mensageria)
  • Orquestração de containers com Kubernetes (K8s)
  • Criação de soluções em AWS (S3, Cognito)
  • Domínio de SQL
  • Consumo de APIs REST/SOAP
  • Linux básico


Conhecimentos desejáveis (diferenciais):

  • Noções de Node.js
  • Experiência em JavaScript
  • Testes unitários com JUnit
  • Integração e entrega contínua via Jenkins
  • Experiência adicional em Kubernetes
  • Experiência consolidada em AWS e arquitetura de microsserviços


- Quais atividades você deverá desempenhar?

Participar do desenvolvimento de soluções usando microserviços e práticas DevOps

Atuar na expansão e manutenção do pipeline de produtos

Contribuir em projetos de crescimento e flexibilidade do negócio

Monitorar e otimizar a performance dos sistemas

Colaborar com a equipe para alcançar os objetivos técnicos e de negócio


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: Engineering Manager - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Engineering Team and help spearhead our growth.

As an Engineering Manager, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our Engineering team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Be in charge of the Human Capital for the Project: hiring, retaining, and firing. Compensation plans, motivation, etc.

- Help in the definition and monitor metrics and KPIs for the teams.

- Make sure that team coordination and the development process are executed correctly.

- Lead all the Scrum ceremonies and its compliance.

- Encourage a collaborative engineering culture according to the company values.


Requirements:


- 10+ Experience in Software Development related roles in a relevant company.

- 5+ Experience as a Project Manager or similar.

- Strong Project Management skills.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Advanced English Level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Location : Remote Brazil

Duration: 12+ months

Rate : DOE


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer – Frontend to join our dynamic engineering team. title: Analista de segurança
description:
Required Skills and Experience:

The ideal candidate will bring foundational experience in security operations with a demonstrated ability to investigate and respond to security events. A strong focus on Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is essential, including the ability to analyze data movement, enforce classification standards, and coordinate remediation efforts. Candidates should be comfortable working in dynamic environments, applying core SOC concepts while developing deeper expertise in protecting sensitive data.


  • Experience in cybersecurity or information technology within a SOC or incident response role.
  • Hands-on experience working with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies and processes.
  • Familiarity with common data classification categories (e.g., PII, PCI, PHI) and their security and compliance implications.
  • Experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems for monitoring, triage, and analysis.
  • Exposure to endpoint protection solutions, including antivirus, EDR, or other detection and response technologies.
  • Experience triaging security incidents in cloud-native and SaaS environments .
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP protocols and OSI Layers 1–4.
  • Ability to analyze event logs and alerts, correlate them with DLP activity, and determine the appropriate remediation.
  • Basic knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), Cyber Kill Chain, and MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting incidents and working with stakeholders during investigations.
  • Ability to maintain integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling sensitive data.
  • Highly organized, efficient, and capable of managing multiple incidents or tasks with minimal supervision.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience tuning or refining DLP policies and rules to improve accuracy and reduce false positives.
  • Familiarity with cloud security controls and data governance concepts (e.g., encryption, access control, retention).
  • Exposure to cybersecurity threat hunting techniques and proactive analysis methods.
  • Basic scripting or automation knowledge (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar) to support repetitive triage tasks.


Education/Certifications/Training Required:

  • Basic industry certification, such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or GIAC.
  • Associates' or Bachelors’ Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security Assurance, or equivalent experience.

title: Dev. Fullstack - Sênior (Integrações)
description:
Somos uma startup que nasceu com o propósito de simplificar a vida dos donos de restaurantes, oferecendo integração com as principais plataformas de delivery e uma solução completa que conecta diferentes frentes da gestão desde pedidos até controle de estoque e fluxo de caixa.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa de Fullstack para atuar de forma estratégica em nosso time, garantindo que nossas soluções acompanhem o ritmo de crescimento e mantenham os mais altos padrões de qualidade.


Requisitos:


  • NodeJS, Angular JS;
  • Container (Docker, Kubernetes), banco de Dados PostgreSQL (SQL Server), e Git (bitbucket);
  • Experiência em Desenvolvimento Ágil (Scrum, Kanban, outros);
  • Desenvolvimento Cloud AWS (SQS, Lambda, ECS, S3, Dynamo)
  • +5 anos de experiência.



Desejável, mas não obrigatório:


  • Loopback 4 (framework);
  • Redis;
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful e webhooks;
  • Mapeamento e transformação de dados (DE-PARA);
  • Processamento assíncrono (ex: AWS SQS) e tolerância a falhas;
  • Experiência com integrações de APIs;
  • Testes de integração, troubleshooting e monitoramento de APIs;
  • Segurança em comunicação entre sistemas (OAuth, autenticação);



Benefícios:


  • Contratação PJ com período de descanso remunerado de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Home Office (no cartão Caju) de R$180/mês;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Day off no mês do aniversário;
  • Desconto Gympass;
  • Kit completo de equipamentos de trabalho;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

title: Marketing Product Manager
description:
Job Responsibilities：

1. Conduct industry market research, demand analysis and competitive analysis in the target region and country, explore new products that match market demands or new application opportunities based on existing products, and promptly feedback to the company headquarters.

2. Be responsible for the research, planning and analysis of business requirements, convert business requirements into product requirements, and write product requirement specification documents.

3. Assist the product launch, support the sales team to complete the new product launch promotion work, support the product sales target.

4. Be responsible for the life cycle management of the product, including providing support and coordination for the operation plans and promotion plans in the early, middle and late stages of product launch.

5. Responsible for analyzing customer demand feedback and understanding internal demands, tracking product operation data, analyzing user feedback, formulating standardized product packages, and optimizing and iterating plans.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or above, majoring in science and engineering or related fields.

2. More than three years of working experience as a product manager, with experience in the analysis of the testing and analysis instrument industry or agricultural markets such as feed and grain and oil crops.

3. Possessing excellent learning ability, one can quickly learn and understand the company's products and applications.

4. Strong logical thinking ability, good insight and analytical skills, capable of observing products and identifying opportunities from both customer needs and market opportunities perspectives simultaneously.

5. Fluent in English and able to travel for frequent business trips within the region.

title: Full-Stack Go Engineer
description:
Own your future:

Our culture isn't something people join, it's something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.

As a Full-Stack Go Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Go, JavaScript, and cloud technologies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build high-quality software solutions, optimize performance, and ensure reliability in a cloud-native infrastructure.


Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Go.
  • Experience and readiness to work with JavaScript (20% of the time)
  • Proficiency in Amazon Web Services (AWS), including deploying and maintaining cloud-based applications.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
  • Upper-Intermediate+ English and ability to communicate effectively with international teams.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Dart
  • Experience and readiness to work with Python.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to both frontend and backend Scripting features.
  • Remediate the bug backlog.
  • Debug and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
  • Perform code reviews.
  • Establish key metrics to identify problems, suggest solutions, and drive resolution.
  • Engage with support teams in triaging and resolving production issues.
  • Participate in team Agile ceremonies.

title: Cientista de Dados
description:
Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Fundamentos Estatísticos:

o Testes de hipótese

o Validação de modelos preditivos

o Métricas de avaliação e explicabilidade de modelos (SHAP, LIME, etc.)

  • Machine Learning & Deep Learning:

o Domínio dos principais algoritmos supervisionados e não supervisionados

o Experiência prática na construção, avaliação e ajuste de modelos

  • Desenvolvimento com Python:

o Conhecimento das principais PEPs (Python Enhancement Proposals)

o Experiência com bibliotecas como scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch

o Desenvolvimento e disponibilização de modelos via APIs (FastAPI, Flask, etc.)

  • Integração com LLMs (Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala):

o Experiência em engenharia de prompts

o Desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes integrados a LLMs (ex: GPT)

  • Plataformas e Ferramentas:

o Experiência com Databricks

o Conhecimento em SQL para manipulação de dados

o Uso de GIT para versionamento de código


Experiência Desejada:

  • Participação em projetos de:

o Construção e publicação de modelos de machine learning

o Disponibilização de modelos como serviços via APIs

o Desenvolvimento de Agentes de IA (Intelligent Agents)


Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação remota
  • Contratação CLT

title: Analista de Produtos e dados
description:
Vaga: Analista de Produtos e dados | Maitha Tech


Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Owner de Dados para atuar de forma estratégica na evolução dos produtos de dados da organização. Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções que geram impacto real, influenciando roadmap, governança e direcionamento técnico, além de fortalecer a cultura data-driven em toda a empresa.

É uma posição de alta visibilidade , interação frequente com stakeholders e forte atuação junto às equipes de Engenharia, Analytics e Negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a construção, evolução e priorização do roadmap dos produtos de dados.
  • Definir OKRs e métricas de sucesso, garantindo entregas de alto valor.
  • Traduzir demandas de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros para Engenharia de Dados.
  • Gerenciar backlog, alinhando necessidades de negócio ao desenvolvimento técnico.
  • Atuar lado a lado com times de Engenharia, Analytics e áreas de negócio.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da squad e promover melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de governança, segurança e compliance de dados.
  • Participar e facilitar cerimônias ágeis.
  • Acompanhar releases e comunicar evoluções às áreas parceiras.


✔ Requisitos

  • Ensino superior em TI, Dados, Engenharia, Negócios ou correlatas.
  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência como PO, Analista de Dados, Engenheiro de Dados ou funções similares.
  • Vivência forte com produtos orientados a dados e atuação com áreas de negócio.
  • Experiência com Scrum/Kanban , priorização de backlog e discovery.
  • Conhecimento em Data Lake ou Data Mesh , especialmente em AWS .
  • Noções sólidas de Engenharia de Dados: PySpark, Python, MongoDB, bancos de dados.
  • Vivência com Power BI .
  • Entendimento de infraestrutura e arquitetura de dados.
  • Familiaridade com OKRs e métricas de produto.
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Perfil analítico, adaptável, com pensamento crítico e senso de dono.


➕ Diferenciais

  • Noções de Machine Learning e IA aplicada a dados.
  • Conhecimento do negócio Alelo .
  • Vivência com governança, qualidade e catalogação de dados.
  • Experiência avançada com AWS .


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remoto


O que você encontrará na Maitha

  • Desenvolvimento individual de soft skills ao longo da jornada.
  • Gestão de bem-estar com indicadores e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Treinamentos, workshops e meetups para evolução técnica e comportamental.
  • Programa de recompensas e premiações.
  • TotalPass com diversas modalidades (musculação, yoga, dança, entre outros).
  • Muito mais em um ambiente colaborativo e de constante evolução!

title: Sourcer Pleno/Senior - INTERNACIONAL
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Pleno/Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação North America e LATAM da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: ABAP Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


We are looking for a skilled ABAP Cloud Clean Core Developer to join our SAP team and support digital transformation initiatives in the pharmaceutical and life sciences sector.


The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in ABAP Cloud and RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model), with a solid understanding of Clean Core principles and the strict compliance standards that govern pharmaceutical operations. This role will involve building upgrade-safe, cloud-ready SAP solutions while ensuring regulatory compliance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain upgrade-safe, extensible solutions in SAP S/4HANA Cloud following Clean Core principles.
  • Use ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) to build modern, cloud-ready applications.
  • Ensure all developments are designed and documented in line with pharmaceutical compliance standards (GxP, CFR Part 11, validation protocols).
  • Collaborate with functional, quality, and compliance teams to deliver solutions that are both technically sound and audit-ready.
  • Develop APIs, CDS views, OData services, and integration scenarios that support regulated business processes.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA transformation projects within manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and regulatory domains.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and validation activities to ensure alignment with IT and QA requirements.
  • Stay current with SAP BTP extensibility, Clean Core roadmap, and pharma industry digital trends.


Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience as an ABAP Developer, with strong expertise in ABAP Cloud and RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model).
  • Solid understanding of Clean Core principles and experience implementing upgrade-safe, extensible solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical compliance standards, including GxP, CFR Part 11, and validation protocols.
  • Experience developing APIs, CDS views, and OData services, as well as supporting complex integration scenarios.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams, including quality and compliance groups.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and regulatory domains in the pharma or life sciences industry is a strong plus.
  • Up-to-date understanding of SAP BTP extensibility and emerging trends in pharma industry digital transformation.


Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience working in pharma, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Knowledge of Fiori/UI5 development and integration.
  • Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) or cloud-based integrations.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and tools for SAP development lifecycle.


Benefits:

  • The opportunity to contribute to a global leader in supply chain innovation and digital transformation.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
About the job


Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time


About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.


  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack


  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background


  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours


How to Apply

Apply here:


  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

title: Desenvolvedor em Copilot Studio / IA Aplicada ao Desenvolvimento PL
description:
Modelo de trabalho: (remoto)

Senioridade: (Pleno)

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Copilot Studio para atuar na construção, integração e evolução de soluções que utilizam copilots de IA voltados ao desenvolvimento, automação e produtividade. O(a) profissional será responsável por aplicar ferramentas de IA generativa em práticas de engenharia de software, apoiar times na adoção dessas tecnologias e garantir o uso seguro e governado dos copilots.


Responsabilidades

  • Criar, configurar e evoluir soluções utilizando Copilot Studio .
  • Utilizar ferramentas como GitHub Copilot , Microsoft Copilot ou copilots similares para aumentar produtividade, qualidade e velocidade de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar equipes no uso de IA para geração, revisão e otimização de código.
  • Integrar copilots a fluxos de trabalho, processos de negócio e plataformas corporativas.
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento utilizando Git/GitHub .
  • Atuar com foco em segurança, governança, compliance e uso responsável de IA.
  • Colaborar com times de tecnologia e negócio para identificar oportunidades de automação com copilots.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática com Copilot Studio .
  • Vivência com GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot ou outras ferramentas de copilots de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento e produtividade.
  • Conhecimentos em uma ou mais linguagens relevantes: Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, etc.
  • ou experiência nas plataformas M365, Power Platform, Dynamics ou Azure .
  • Capacidade de criar, revisar e otimizar código com suporte de IA.
  • Entendimento de boas práticas de versionamento com Git/GitHub .
  • Noções de segurança , compliance e governança aplicadas a soluções de IA generativa.

Diferenciais (Desejável)

  • Experiência com integração de copilots em fluxos de trabalho e processos corporativos.
  • Certificações em IA, Azure, Power Platform ou GitHub.
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e engenharia de plataformas.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Customer Service Representative - Relocation Required
description:
Vantage is a global, multi-regulated, multi-asset broker based in Sydney, offering clients access to trading CFDs on Forex, Commodities, Indices, Shares, and Cryptocurrencies. With over 10 years of market experience, Vantage has a strong presence with more than 1,000 employees across 30 global offices. Vantage provides a trusted trading ecosystem and a user-friendly platform for clients to capitalize on trading opportunities.


OPEN ONLY to Portuguese native speakers who are willing to relocate.


This is a unique opportunity for Customer Service Rockstars interested in living and developing a career in Southeast Asia: Malaysia or Thailand . The company will provide all necessary visa assistance and relocation support. During the visa processing, work remotely from your base country.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide front-line support to our customers via live chats, phones, and email.
  • Answering queries and resolving client issues regarding our products, platforms, and promotions.
  • Address customer feedback as well as complaints professionally.
  • Record and update customer data and other relevant information when necessary.
  • Supporting documentation/administrative needs within the department and supporting translation for customer announcement notices.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree, fresh graduates welcome to apply.
  • Over 2 years of experience in Customer Service, highly preferred in crypto or fintech, but any industry welcome.
  • Mandatory rotation shift schedule with night-shifts once relocated.
  • Experience in international settings and teams.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is MANDATORY
  • Exceptional communication skills with a superb client focus.
  • Logical and analytical approach to problem-solving.
  • Knowledge or interest in trading is highly desirable, but not essential.


We offer :

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Remote work while relocation is processed
  • Local benefits according to the chosen relocation country
  • Relocation support, including visa sponsorship and additional expenses
  • Career development in a fast-paced industry

title: Python Developer - SR/PL
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

As a Python Developer, it is expected that the ideal candidate understands a broad range of computer science concepts and their applicability. This person can dive deeply into a wide range of technical problems, offering suggestions and feedback to their team and can also help to understand the requirements, and translate to an architectural design and help to plan and implement this solution for those requirements.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Actively support the development teams;
  • Mentor less experienced team members;
  • Drive team to innovate and deliver roadmap features with agility and high quality;
  • Digest requirements from product team and work on solutions with performance and scalability features for cloud systems;
  • Development of new features;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches by elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Participation in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, development, and testing;
  • Participation in technical discussions with customers;
  • Perform code reviews;
  • Conduct yourself as a trusted technical advisor;
  • Follow agile processes and participate actively in all development phases.


Essential Skills

  • Experience leading development teams;
  • Proficiency with development in Python versions 2 and 3;
  • Experience with pyTest;
  • Experience with Linux environments, CLI commands, Shell Script and logs;
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with GIT;
  • Experience with Github, GIT, code;
  • Knowledge of Agile development (e.g. using Scrum, Kanban, etc.).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • NETCONF/YANG.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

Our client is loong for a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer to join a global product-focused technology team responsible for building large-scale web platforms used by millions of users. This role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, engineering-driven environment with strong ownership, modern cloud architectures, and end-to-end autonomy.


What You Will Do

  • Design and build responsive, web-based applications and learning tools used at scale.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver impactful user-centric features.
  • Own the full software development lifecycle: architecture, development, testing, deployment, observability, and maintenance.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code and monitoring best practices to ensure highly reliable applications.
  • Collaborate with a high-performing engineering group built around autonomy and extreme ownership.


What You Bring

Mandatory Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Java , ideally with Spring or Spring Boot.
  • Experience with Angular (preferred) or React.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful services , microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , automated testing, and DevOps-oriented workflows.
  • Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL).
  • Experience with AWS services for cloud-native application development.
  • Understanding of Docker and containerization concepts.
  • Experience with observability tools to monitor application health.
  • Solid understanding of backend engineering, with some experience across the full stack (front-end + backend).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Terraform (highly desirable).
  • Experience developing B2B or B2C product engineering solutions at scale.
  • Experience building accessible, high-performance, responsive web applications .
  • Knowledge of distributed caching solutions (e.g., Redis).
  • Experience deploying applications on Tomcat or similar application servers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

title: QA Engineer (Salesforce)
description:

Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Quality Engineer to join their high-performing engineering organization as they continue to innovate and scale their global product suite. As a leader in tech scouting and innovation management software, our partner empowers the world's top companies and research institutions to accelerate discovery, collaboration, and operational excellence.


As an Al-First Quality Engineer, you will go beyond writing and executing test cases. You will harness the power of Al to predict defects, optimize test coverage, and accelerate delivery. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how intelligent quality practices are embedded into every stage of their software development lifecycle.


What You'll Do:

  • Use Al-driven tools to generate, maintain, and optimize test cases, test data, and test automation against application(s) running on the Salesforce Platform
  • Strategically prioritize and drive forward the QA practice with a high degree of autonomy

￮ Identify and propose strategies for technical and testing problems affecting the team, communicate standards clearly, and secure buy-in on solutions.

￮ Champion use of AI to automate repetitive and time-consuming QA tasks, freeing the team to focus on high-impact testing, exploratory scenarios, and strategic quality improvements

￮ Manage and mitigate technical and testing risk across projects, ensuring the right testing scope and sequencing to achieve team objectives and enable faster, safer releases.

￮ Leverage predictive analytics to identify defect-prone areas and prioritize risk-based testing.

  • Collaborate with developers, architects, and product managers to integrate Al-powered quality checks into CI/CD pipelines and unblock Al-powered workflows
  • Validate AI/ML based functionality for accuracy and reliability as part of the release process.


What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of proven experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles.

￮ Experience across the breadth of application testing types: end-to-end testing, load and volume performance testing, API testing, etc.

  • Proven experience with testing against the Salesforce Platform

￮ Understanding of platform and change management concepts: sandboxes, templates, packages, and changesets. Experience with Salesforce Second-Generation Managed Packages is strongly desired.

￮ Knowledge of platform limits and constraints to inform data volume testing

￮ Experience administering Salesforce and/or strong Salesforce configuration skills

  • Strong programming skills, with familiarity across several languages (C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, SQL, etc.).
  • Understanding of Al/ML concepts and hands-on experience using Al-enabled development and testing tools
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright preferred) and their intersection with Al tools (such as Playwright MCP Server)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud-native environments.
  • Self-driven work style, with initiative to exploring, learning, and applying novel concepts and techniques
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a mindset for experimentation and continuous improvement.
  • Experience in analyzing data sets for defect prediction, anomaly detection, or performing root cause analysis.


Work Schedule: You MUST be able to work during core U.S. Time Zone working hours.  


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a growing company at the forefront of Salesforce-driven enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

title: Staff Product Engineer (Software)
description:
Staff Product Engineer (Software)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Compensation: $60,000 USD / year

Annual Bonus: $6,000 (10%)

Backed By: Top Silicon Valley investors — Y Combinator, Liquid 2, Founder of Instacart, Founder of Reddit

Stage: High-growth consumer health tech subscription product generating $1M/month , compounding 15% MoM

TAM: $29.4B in the U.S. (100M people). ~600M people globally.

Career Growth: As our first full-time Staff Engineer , you will set engineering standards, establish technical direction, and grow the engineering team.


About the Job

As a Staff Software Engineer on Product , you will directly shape our customer-facing web app (tens of thousands of MAU) and own our highest-priority engineering initiatives. You’ll partner closely with the Product Designer, both Founders, and lead our engineering team to build reliable software that drives customer retention and product velocity.

You’ll spend ~75% of your time writing code and ~25% on technical direction, architectural decisions, and collaborating on the product roadmap .

You will operate in a Build → Measure → Learn + Iterate product loop.


About You

  • 8+ years building full-stack applications with Python and JavaScript
  • 4+ years of production React experience
  • Able to translate Figma designs into scalable React/Python implementations
  • Strong product-growth instincts and experience with event instrumentation
  • Skilled with PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar tools
  • Exceptional communicator who builds trust, aligns teams, and drives decisions
  • Staff-level depth: setting technical direction, making architectural tradeoffs, delivering impact
  • Adept at balancing technical debt, infra cost, engineering hours, and time-to-ship
  • Comfortable in fast-paced startup environments where engineers own infra end-to-end


Our Stack

  • Python (FastAPI) — backend
  • TypeScript (React) — frontend
  • Postgres (Supabase)
  • PostHog for product analytics
  • AWS
  • GitHub


What You’ll Do1. Build

  • Work with the Product Designer and Founders to define the technical direction
  • Translate customer feedback and Figma screens into clear technical requirements
  • Break down work across yourself + 2 Full-Stack Engineers + 1 AI Engineer
  • Own architecture, core features, and high-quality implementation
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the codebase

2. Measure

  • Instrument all necessary customer events inside our web app
  • Ensure PostHog receives clean, reliable data for evaluating retention and feature impact

3. Learn + Iterate

  • Partner with the Product Designer and CTO to build charts/dashboards in PostHog
  • Extract insights quickly to inform product decisions
  • Ship iterations rapidly and maintain a fast learning cycle

Estamos mais fortes do que nunca e acreditamos que através da riqueza que há nas pessoas, engajamos o nosso time para continuar alcançando os melhores resultados.


Nossas vagas estão abertas para todas e todos, independentemente da idade, deficiência, raça, gênero ou orientação sexual.


Venha construir uma carreira de sucesso!


#souarrozcomfeijão

  • Análise e acompanhamento de KPI's: MAPE, BIAS, OTIF, CFR;
  • Avaliação de tendências, riscos e oportunidades para a malha de distribuição logística;
  • Desenvolvimento de Dashboards de indicadores de performance;
  • Apoiar na organização e análise de dados de estoques mitigando riscos de descarte;
  • Apoiar na manutenção de sistemas e ferramentas de planejamento;
  • Forte interação com as áreas: Vendas, Marketing, Produção e Logística.


Requisitos:

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Desejável conhecimento em SQL / Power BI;
  • Necessário conhecimento em Python;
  • Perfil analítico, proatividade e boa comunicação;
  • Interesse em Supply Chain e planejamento estratégico.

title: Global CRM Sustain & Operations Lead
description:
Global CRM Sustain & Operations Lead


As a Sustain & Operations Lead, you will be responsible for the management, quality, analysis, and lead of Global CRM system under your responsibility following the appropriate methodologies.


The functions are:


  • Provide Recommendations, Action Plans, and Status Updates to Leadership and Key Stakeholders
  • Manage Key Relationships with Business and Technical Stakeholders
  • Interaction with key users of the applications and Align application services with business goals to ensure efficiency and value delivery
  • Continually mature Sustain & Operational/Platform processes to meet Otis needs & requirements
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the production environment, ensuring system stability, performance, reliability & quality
  • Ensuring adherence to all policies, procedures, KPI’s, SLA’s, best practices are being properly tracked & completed. Continue to enhance & mature proper tracking/adherence with vendors/teams.
  • Focus, shorten & fine tune KPI’s to ensure internal teams are focused on correcting the area’s that provide most value
  • Enforce/champion/leverage & expand our AI usage/capabilities in day-to-day operations with internal sustain/workstream teams (includes vendors)
  • Continue to improve reports on support activities, incident trends, and system health for stakeholders
  • Promote continuous improvement by identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements
  • Ensure/Drive Problem Management and follow best in class practices, implementing preventive measures and meeting Otis level objectives
  • Troubleshooting issues, coordinating with development teams, and implementing best practices for incident management and resolution
  • Ensure/enforce the integrity, data, administration, configuration, maintenance of all Global CRM environments (non-production & production)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, business analysts, cyber, infrastructure teams) to address complex technical challenges
  • Ensure/implement production monitoring for all integration system connected to production CRM & address any monitoring coverage gaps
  • Assist with new global initiatives with the Global CRM Implementation & Rollout COE team
  • Lead the audit/compliance initiatives for Global CRM, working with the auditing/compliance/DR teams
  • Approve /coordinate with appropriate teams/vendors on the environment server/maintenance upgrades/license management/platform items
